["$r",null,null,{"children":[["$r","h2",null,{"id":"项目简介","children":"项目简介"}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":[["$r","a",null,{"href":"https://github.com/gentoo-zh/overlay","rel":"nofollow","children":"gentoo-zh"}]," 是 Gentoo 中文社区维护的 overlay，前身为 2003 年的 gentoo-tw 与 gentoo-china，收录大量中文用户常用的软件包。"]}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["本仓库镜像其 distfiles 与二进制包，overlay 本身见 ",["$r","a",null,{"href":"../gentoo-zh.git/","children":"gentoo-zh Overlay Git"}],"。"]}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["完整的包列表（含二进制包状态）请",["$r","a",null,{"href":"https://distfiles.gentoozh.org/packages","rel":"nofollow","children":"点击这里"}],"查看。"]}],"
",["$r","h2",null,{"id":"启用-overlay","children":"启用 overlay"}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":"先启用 overlay，二进制包与 distfiles 都只是加速下载："}],"
",["$r","CodeBlock",null,{"menus":[],"templateId":"template-0","codeLanguage":"bash"}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["overlay 本身也有 Git 镜像，见 ",["$r","a",null,{"href":"../gentoo-zh.git/","children":"gentoo-zh Overlay Git"}],"。"]}],"
",["$r","h2",null,{"id":"distfiles","children":"Distfiles"}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["追加到 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"/etc/portage/make.conf"}],"："]}],"
",["$r","CodeBlock",null,{"menus":[],"templateId":"template-1","filepath":"/etc/portage/make.conf","enableQuickSetup":true,"append":true}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["只有 overlay 的源码，不能替代官方源，因此是追加。地址不写 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"distfiles/"}],"，Portage 会自己补上。官方源见 ",["$r","a",null,{"href":"../gentoo/","children":"Gentoo 软件仓库"}],"。"]}],"
",["$r","h2",null,{"id":"二进制包","children":"二进制包"}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":"上游每晚构建并签名，目前只有 amd64。"}],"
",["$r","h3",null,{"id":"导入签名公钥","children":"导入签名公钥"}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["Portage 用自己的密钥环 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"/etc/portage/gnupg"}],"，该目录由 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"getuto"}]," 建立，顺序不能颠倒："]}],"
",["$r","CodeBlock",null,{"menus":[],"templateId":"template-2","codeLanguage":"bash"}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["验签以 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"portage"}]," 用户执行，它对 trustdb 没有写入权限，所以要先 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"--check-trustdb"}]," 算好。"]}],"
",["$r","h3",null,{"id":"添加仓库","children":"添加仓库"}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["写入 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"/etc/portage/binrepos.conf/gentoo-zh.conf"}],"："]}],"
",["$r","CodeBlock",null,{"menus":[],"templateId":"template-3","filepath":"/etc/portage/binrepos.conf/gentoo-zh.conf","enableQuickSetup":true}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["用 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"binrepos.conf"}]," 而不是 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"PORTAGE_BINHOST"}],"：后者是隐式仓库，无法单独设置 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"verify-signature"}],"。"]}],"
",["$r","h3",null,{"id":"打开-getbinpkg","children":"打开 getbinpkg"}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["追加到 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"/etc/portage/make.conf"}],"："]}],"
",["$r","CodeBlock",null,{"menus":[],"templateId":"template-4","filepath":"/etc/portage/make.conf","enableQuickSetup":true,"append":true}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["不要用全局的 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"FEATURES=binpkg-request-signature"}],"，它会覆盖上一步的 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"verify-signature"}],"，并要求本机 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"buildpkg"}]," 编出的包也带签名，那些包默认没有签名，每次本地构建都会报 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"GnuPG verification failed"}],"。"]}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["若 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"emerge"}]," 仍编译源码，用 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"emerge -pv"}]," 检查，前缀为 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"[binary]"}]," 才是采用了二进制包；USE 不完全匹配时 Portage 不会用。"]}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["上游说明：",["$r","a",null,{"href":"https://distfiles.gentoozh.org","rel":"nofollow","children":"https://distfiles.gentoozh.org"}]]}]]}]
